editorial.headline: Passenger Space Transport: Open Nationally, Address-Specific in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers passenger journeys by launch vehicle, including operated rentals, with national PMA openness and no stated Bali moratorium block.
editorial.body:
Passenger space transport is the business of moving people by launch vehicle. This activity covers passenger journeys across all kinds of routes and launch schedules, so its definition is not limited to a particular itinerary or cadence. It also includes hiring space transport together with its operator when the purpose is to carry passengers. The central boundary is equally clear: this is an activity for passenger movement, not the carriage of goods.

Who may register it is set out in direct terms. The record opens the activity to Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar enterprises. That span means the classification itself does not reserve the activity to only one of the four named business scales; each is expressly included. For a founder, the practical reading is simple: the registered activity needs to reflect passenger space transport, including operated rental arrangements where they are used to carry passengers. It is a defined transport activity, rather than a catch-all label for every space-related undertaking.

Nationally, the PMA status is TERBUKA and the foreign-ownership ceiling is 100%. In plain English, foreign investment is open at the national level and may reach full foreign ownership for this activity. Bali requires its own reading rather than an assumption that the national result automatically settles the island-wide position. Here, the Bali status is OK_or_HIGHER_RISK: the activity is described as medium-high/high risk and is not blocked by the moratorium. That matters because the stated Bali moratorium blocks PMA registration for all low- and medium-low-risk activities across the province, permanently. The honest result is that this activity is open nationally and is not blocked for PMA in Bali under the stated moratorium, while its treatment must still be verified for the relevant address.
